name: Service Call
description: Call a local HTTP service with a templated request body. The connected input is substituted into the body template; the response is parsed and an optional path extracts the field you want.
doc:
**Service** is a generic HTTP caller — point it at any local engine you run yourself.

**Pick a Service Preset** to fill the endpoint + method + body template + response path in one click (Ollama / LM Studio / ComfyUI / Whisper / generic). Manage your own presets in **Settings → Services** (web) or paste templates inline on the node.

**Templating** — the connected `input` is available as:
  - `{{input}}` — JSON-escaped + quoted (safe to drop into a JSON string slot)
  - `{{inputRaw}}` — raw substitution (use when input is already a JSON object/array)
  - `{{apiKey}}` — resolves the **API Key Constant**
  - `{{model}}` — the **Model** field
  - `{{system}}` — the **System Message** field (chat/LLM bodies)

**Response Path** uses dot/bracket notation: `choices.0.message.content`, `data[0].url`, etc. Leave blank to return the parsed body whole.

**Inline overrides win** — any field you fill on the node overrides the same field from the selected preset.

inputs.name: Input
inputs.description: The data to send — referenced as {{input}} (JSON-escaped) or {{inputRaw}} (raw) in the body template.

outputs.name: Response
outputs.description: The extracted response (via Response Path) or the parsed body when path is blank.

properties.name: Service Preset
properties.description: Pick a built-in or saved service. The fields below override the preset's values.

properties.name: Model
properties.description: Model name sent to the service. Substituted into the body template as {{model}}; legacy templates with a literal model string are rewritten in place when this changes. Leave blank to inherit from the service preset.

properties.name: System Message (LLM)
properties.description: Optional system prompt for chat/LLM services (llama.cpp, Ollama, OpenAI-compatible). Substituted into the body as {{system}} (JSON-escaped). The built-in chat presets already include a {"role":"system"} slot, so just fill this in; for a custom body add {"role": "system", "content": {{system}}}.

properties.name: Body Template
properties.description: Request body. Use {{input}} (JSON-escaped) or {{inputRaw}} for raw substitution. Ignored for GET/HEAD.

properties.name: Response Path
properties.description: Dot/bracket path to extract from the response. Blank = return the whole parsed body.

properties.name: Headers (JSON template)
properties.description: HTTP headers as JSON. {{apiKey}} resolves the API Key Constant. Blank = Content-Type: application/json.

properties.name: API Key Constant
properties.description: Name of a Project Constant whose value is the API key, accessible as {{apiKey}} in headers + body.
